status: Frozen development plan before running this extension; not external preregistration or held-out evaluation
purpose: Separate a physical receiving frontend from a controller that sees only four terminal outputs, instrument addresses, ranges and a public task. Test conditional history-based reconstruction without direct access to latent receiver state.
sourceBoundary: Heath 2020 supplies a steady-state recurrent-circuit precedent, not native time constants. Schnaitmann 2024 supplies additional receiving-role constraints. Reuse the existing engineered rate model unchanged; do not call this the authors' fitted model or physiological identification.

publicOutputInterface.terminal: Four current rate deviations; sampled even in the zero-drive absence convention

historyDecoder: An exact model-based unknown-input observer uses current and previous terminal output plus its own scalar latent estimate. Proposed coefficients and zero initialization are known in the matched case. The observer is not a learned biological mechanism. Cross-view prototypes are learned from the same public cued evidence as the baseline.
currentOnlyDecoder: Five-feature ridge regression using current four terminal outputs and a constant, trained on the same 512 public calibration transitions. No latent-state or past-output feature.
trainingBoundary: Reuse byte-fixed public calibration and cued teaching inputs. Fit current-only weights once. Acquire observer prototypes using matched, zero-initialized receiving and observer coefficients. Freeze every prototype/decoder parameter across main episodes; mismatch cases do not receive post-change retraining.
evaluation: Same six scenarios, four seeds and 24 steps as the frozen base plan. All 144 episodes are development evidence. Existing five sealed sessions stay unopened. No raw recordings are acquired.
measures: latent-estimation error recorded by external evaluator only
controls: matched observer follows the exact discrete dynamics
unknown initial state follows derived estimation-error recursion
prior-state and direct reference reproduce their preserved actions
reference-return and target-query code reused unchanged
